item.title: Ask Murph for a group chat by name or people
item.summary: From your private Murph, you can now ask about or share into an existing joined iMessage group by its chat name or by the people in it.
item.details: Murph uses only your own shared Contacts when available. Otherwise it offers limited clues such as area code and last four digits. When Murph can safely distinguish possible matches, it asks which one; otherwise it says it cannot identify the group. New joined groups also keep their existing iMessage title when one is available.
